list.title: Collectibles
list.description: Rare items signed by the heroes, with live bidding. Simulated payment.
list.emptyDescription: When a signed item goes live, it shows up here with its countdown.
list.legal: Demo environment: bids and payment are simulated, with no real charge. Third-party brands and images are not used.

rules.increments: Each bid adds one of the button amounts to the current bid. The first bid starts from the starting bid.
rules.antiSnipe: A bid in the last 2 minutes extends the end to 2 minutes after that bid.
rules.selfOutbid: If you are already winning you can't outbid yourself. One bid every 2 seconds per person.
rules.payment: The winner completes the simulated payment and the order shows up in My purchases.

room.bidsCount: {n, plural, =0 {No bids yet} =1 {1 bid} other {# bids}}
room.winningHint: You're winning. The buttons come back if someone outbids you.
room.quickBidHint: Tap an amount to see the total and confirm.
room.loginToBid: Sign in to bid. You can watch without signing in.
room.adminCannotBid: Admin accounts can watch but not bid.
room.feedScheduled: Bids show up here as soon as the item goes live.
room.feedEmpty: No bids yet. Be the first!

toast.extended: It was close: the end was extended by 2 minutes.

errors.account_suspended: Your account is suspended and can't bid.
errors.creator_cannot_bid: Heroes can't bid on their own item.
errors.auction_ended: Time is up. That bid didn't go through.
errors.auction_not_live: This item isn't taking bids yet.
errors.invalid_increment: Invalid bid amount. Use one of the buttons.
errors.generic: We couldn't place the bid. Try again.

confirm.title: Confirm bid
confirm.description: The amount may go up if someone bids before you confirm.
confirm.antiSnipe: Less than 2 minutes left: your bid extends the end by 2 minutes.
confirm.simulated: Demo: no real charge. If you win, payment is simulated.

standing.winningHint: Your bid is the highest so far.
standing.outbidHint: Place a new bid to get back in front.
standing.wonHint: Your bid of {price} won. Complete the simulated payment to create the order.
standing.cancelledHint: The admin cancelled this item. No bid counts.
standing.scheduled: This item isn't live yet. Bidding opens when the countdown reaches zero.
standing.scheduledAnon: This item isn't live yet. Sign in to bid when it opens.

pay.title: Pay for your win
pay.description: Pick a fictional destination and confirm. Nothing is charged.
pay.banner: Simulated payment: no real charge and no real address. The order shows up in My purchases.
pay.simulated: Demo: this is a test order and follows the simulated shipping.

errors.forbidden: Only the winner can complete this payment.
errors.generic: We couldn't complete it. Try again.

purchases.title: My purchases
purchases.description: Your test orders and your collectible bids.

myBids.emptyDescription: Items you bid on show up here, each with its status.

admin.title: Collectibles
admin.description: Signed items with live bidding. Create a draft, review it and launch now or schedule.
admin.unavailable: Collectibles unavailable: apply migration 0054 to the database.
admin.newDescription: The item starts as a draft. Launching or scheduling is on the detail page.
admin.livePanelHint: Updates by itself. Names are masked, as for the public.

form.title: Title
form.heroHint: Optional. The item also shows on the hero's page while live or scheduled.
form.photosHint: One address per line (up to 8): app path (/collectibles/…) or https://. Don't use logos or brand images.
form.authenticityHint: Certificate, serial number, how the signature was recorded.
form.lockedHint: The item has started: price, buttons and duration are locked.
form.incrementsHint: 1 to 4 different amounts, in reais. E.g. 10, 50, 100.

errors.title: Use 3 to 120 characters.
errors.price: Enter an amount of at least R$ 1.00.
errors.duration: Duration goes from 5 minutes to 30 days.
errors.photos: Up to 8 addresses, each starting with / or https://.

launch.endsNow: Starts now and ends {minutes} minutes later.
launch.pickDate: Pick the start date and time.

cancel.title: Cancel this collectible?
cancel.description: Bids stop counting and bidders see the item as cancelled. This can't be undone.

errors.forbidden: Only the admin can do this.
errors.collectible_locked: The item has started: price, buttons and duration can't change anymore.
errors.invalid_increment: Invalid bid buttons: 1 to 4 positive, different amounts.
errors.invalid_photo: Invalid photo address: use / or https://.
errors.invalid_start: The start can't be in the past.
